text:
elena: quick heads-up — planning to start a twilight canary for slim-kernel + quant-v5 at 23:00 PT. small slice, need pin/rollback plan.

sam: ack. what's the initial traffic slice? and pin TTL?

elena: start 0.5% traffic, hold 30m -> 1% -> 5% if green. pin TTL 6h if we need to force.

maria: adding perf checks: p50 and p95 token latency, and embedding throughput. would like an automatic rollback on regressions.

sam: suggest these guard thresholds:
```
# rollback triggers
p50_increase_pct > 25% OR p95_increase_pct > 40% OR error_rate > 0.5%
```
If any fire for 5m window during canary, auto-rollback.

leo: pls ensure US-west is held back until we sanity thermal sim there. last time west had thermal bump. recommend manual pin for west region.

elena: ok — will route canary to non-west regions first. @deploy-bot can you schedule with pinned-region filter?

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for 1751234567 at 2025-06-12T23:00:00-07:00 (canary slice start 0.5%). routing: all-regions EXCEPT us-west. auto-rollback hooks attached.

ops: double-checking infra capacity — we have 10% spare at that window but should avoid large batch jobs during canary. ops will post a quiesce window.

maria: also adding smoke eval set: 6 prompts for correctness and 3 perf probes. will run every 10m.

elena: release notes — small bullet: "slim-kernel: optimized MatMul kernels; quant-v5 improved size/speed tradeoff; staged canary rollout with auto-rollback". anyone want wording changes?

sam: add "fallback: quant-v4" and that we may pin regionally.

leo: if we need to force-pin older kernel in west use: `rbctl pin kernel:slim-v3 --region us-west --ttl 12h`

elena: good. keep a manual runbook handy: if rollback triggers, ops will run `deploy-bot abort 1751234567` then `rbctl unpin --all` to restore.

deploy-bot: preflight checks completed: build artifact verified, checksums match, canary image signed.

maria: telemetry dashboards updated, alerting rule created `canary-quant-regress` with the thresholds Sam suggested.

sam: one more ask — add a short note in release notes about how quality is validated (smoke prompts + perf thresholds). reduces support noise.

elena: will add. final checklist: 1) docs updated, 2) ops quiesce posted, 3) deploy-bot scheduled, 4) roll/rollback hooks live, 5) release notes updated.

leo: :thumbsup:

maria: :eyes: will monitor first 2 windows.

sam: oncall standby between 23:00-02:00 PT.

elena: thanks — will post a short post-canary summary in #release-notes and ping product if any quality fuzz.

deploy-bot: rollout started at 2025-06-12T23:00:00-07:00. canary slice=0.5%.

maria: first 10m smoke all green. perf within baseline.

(END)
